description: Retained-mode terminal UI framework for .NET 10 with mutable controls, deterministic layout and input, Unicode-aware rendering, styling, dialogs, windows, and managed console hosting.
releaseNotes: SharpVision 1.6.0-beta.5 prerelease: the Turbo Vision theme now looks like Turbo Vision - a light-gray menu and status strip with black text and Borland's red access keys that drop-down menus share, gray dialogs with a white active frame and a green close mark on the blue desktop, black-on-cyan input, button, check-box, and radio-button faces on which those red access keys stay legible (the earlier navy-on-blue mapping made every button and check-box mnemonic vanish), green selection, white-on-blue press feedback, and a blue accent for scrollbar thumbs and progress fills. Since 1.6.0-beta.4, in which the Turbo Vision theme started following Borland's cpAppColor/cpGrayDialog roles on the CGA palette (blue desktop, gray dialogs with a white active frame, green selection, black lines and shadows, [X]/(•) marks through the "classic" glyph family), a Screen paints the theme's application-window plane so a desktop color shows without a hand-authored root face, a menu bar heading insets its caption by one cell on each side so the highlight reads " File ", and menu boxes and dialogs paint their frame cells on their own plane. Since 1.6.0-beta.2, in which menu bars started to behave like desktop menu bars - a drop-down hanging off a bar hosted above other content paints its own Bar plane and popup frame instead of showing that content through its rows (an IsAppearanceBoundary ends a continuous background plane), Up/Down in a drop-down move the cursor without opening submenu rows or trapping focus in a child, a closed submenu forgets its cursor and closes its nested branches leaf-first so reopening never resurrects a stale highlight, a hover-opened submenu shows no cursor until a row inside it is picked, and closing the chain returns focus to the control that owned it before the menu was entered. An application now holds at most one non-empty text selection: selecting in one owner collapses every other owner's range. Since 1.6.0-beta.1, which opened the control-authoring surface so a foreign control family can be built on the same seams the shipped controls use - new authoring bases (ScrollableCompositeControlBase, NumericInputBase, TemporalInputBase, ChartControlBase, FileDialogBase, ItemCollection<TItem>) and ControlBase capabilities for press and drag gestures, owned drop-down popups, modal sessions, owner-bound timers (ControlTimer), and glyph resolution, with the ItemsControl, InputBase, Container, and FloatingSurfaceBase pipeline hooks published rather than internal. Also fixes layout and scrolling correctness (Overlay navigation-slot walking, Container popup and BringIntoView arrangement coherence, monotone scrollbar reservations, ArrangeUniformRows offset remapping, Percent/Star lengths rebased against Viewport), selection integrity (spurious TabControl/Table events, in-flight proposals invalidated on batched structural changes), word-wrap trailing whitespace with O(log n) word navigation, and culture-invariant geometry and layout formatting. See https://github.com/pavkam/sharp-vision/blob/main/docs/index.md for API contracts, examples, and current support.
title: SharpVision
